reason: Conversation 2 reached the door catch within two efficient questions, stated the diagnosis confidently once the snapped tongue and 'runs only while held' evidence appeared, explicitly warned against holding, wedging or bypassing the door switch, and correctly pointed to a door catch/handle part pending the model number without needless escalation.
